### AI Enrichment
https://www.valyu.ai//ai-enrichment

# Your content, rebuilt for AI.

Publishing formats were designed for readers, not agents. Valyu Enrichment converts your catalogue into structured, AI-retrievable content — with metadata, labelled images, and clean markdown built in. No engineering. No maintenance.

## PROCESSED CONTENT UNLOCKS AI REVENUE

 Unprocessed content earns nothing from AI. We handle the enrichment — chunking, table extraction, metadata structuring — so your content is ready for every AI agent, search, and citation.  

## YOUR CONTENT EARNS ON EVERY RETRIEVAL

Every retrieval is metered. Every citation is attributed back to the source. You see which content is being used, by which applications, and how much revenue it generates. Your 2020 work still earning in 2025     

### AI Distribution | Valyu
https://www.valyu.ai//ai-distribution

# Your Next Audience Is AI Context

AI agents and answer engines are reshaping how content is consumed. We help you distribute into this ecosystem, with attribution, tracking, and monetisation rails built in.


## How Valyu enables AI distribution

### Step 1

We accept content in any format and at any volume, including PDFs, XML, EPUB, scanned documents, and image archives. Connect your catalogue once and we handle everything from there.

### Step 2

Raw files are parsed and restructured into AI-ready content. Text is chunked for context windows, tables are extracted, images are labelled, and metadata is generated. The output is clean structured markdown with a consistent schema, regardless of what went in.

### Step 3

Your enriched content is indexed on Valyu's retrieval platform. We build and maintain the search indices, MCP servers, and API endpoints so AI agents and applications can retrieve your content at scale.

### Step 4

Your content becomes available to AI agents, RAG pipelines, LLM applications, and research tools. When an agent searches for expertise in your domain, your content surfaces automatically.

### Step 5

Every retrieval is metered and every citation is attributed back to the source. You choose the monetisation model, whether that is pay-per-retrieval, ads, referrals, or API licensing, and we handle pricing, metering, and reporting.

## Legal

### VALYU ACCEPTABLE USE POLICY
https://www.valyu.ai//valyu-acceptable-use-policy

# Acceptable Use Policy

VALYU ACCEPTABLE USE POLICY (AUP)

Last updated: 06/11/25

This Acceptable Use Policy ("AUP") applies to all access to and use of Valyu's APIs, datasets, models, indexes, and related services (the "Services"). By using the Services, you agree to comply with this AUP. Valyu may update this AUP at any time, and your continued use of the Services constitutes acceptance of the updated version.

1. Definitions

1.1 Restricted Partner Content

"Restricted Partner Content" means any content, data, metadata, text, images, tables, charts, figures, abstracts, summaries, references, or other materials made available through the Services that are licensed to Valyu by third-party rights holders ("Partners", "Partner"), including publishers, data providers, aggregators, or research organisations, and that are subject to contractual use restrictions imposed by those Partners. Restricted Partner Content includes, without limitation, Outputs, snippets, citations, metadata, summaries, extracted entities, or any other derived material that incorporate, reference, or are generated using such Partner-licensed content, whether provided directly by Valyu or surfaced through Valyu's APIs.

2. General Principles

You may use the Services only for lawful purposes and in accordance with this AUP, the Platform Service Agreement, and all endpoint-specific documentation. You are responsible for all activity performed under your API keys.

3. Prohibited Uses

You may not use the Services to:

3.1. Illegal, Harmful, or Abusive Activity

Break any applicable law or regulationHarm, threaten, or harass individualsGenerate or distribute malware or security exploitsImpersonate individuals or entitiesAccess or use the Services in ways that could damage or impair Valyu systems

4. Content Restrictions

You may not use the Services to:

4.1. Circumvent Rights, Copyrights, or Licensing Restrictions

Reproduce or redistribute copyrighted contentAccess content behind paywalls or access controlsStore or display publisher content in ways not allowed by licensingExtract, store, or manipulate full-text articles from licensed sourcesUse the Services to access data you are not legally entitled to

4.2. Build, Recreate, or Compete with Datasets

You may not:

Rebuild, replicate, or simulate any Valyu corpus, dataset, index, or scoringJoin Outputs to reassemble source materialsScrape or bulk download data via high-volume search queriesPerform "benchmark dumping" (large-scale exporting of output)

4.3. Use Outputs to Create Derived or Competitive Products

You may not:

Develop search engines, RAG corpora, knowledge bases, embeddings, LLMs, datasets, indexes, or generative models that compete with ValyuUse Outputs as seeds for synthetic data that replicates licensed or indexed contentUse Outputs to build evaluation datasets for model training without written permission

5. Model Training & Machine Learning Restrictions

This is a zero-tolerance category due to Partner obligations. You may not, under any circumstances, use:

OutputsCitationsSummariesMetadataExtracted entitiesAnnotations (or any other content returned by Valyu) for any machine-learning-related activity described below.

5.1. Prohibited Training, Fine-Tuning, Pre-Training, and Distillation

You may not use any Valyu content or publisher content to:

Train, fine-tune, pre-train, adapt, or calibrate any machine learning modelTrain or update:Large Language Models (LLMs)Embedding or retrieval modelsClassifier or ranking modelsEvaluation or reward modelsSynthetic data generatorsPerform model distillation, compression, imitation or behavioural replication

5.2. Prohibited Dataset Construction and Vectorisation

You may not:

Embed Outputs into a vector storeCreate, augment, or curate datasets partially or wholly derived from OutputsGenerate synthetic corpora seeded by OutputsStore Outputs or derivatives in structured or unstructured datasetsFeed Outputs into agentic retraining loops, auto-labelling systems, or RL pipelines

5.3. Use Valyu Outputs in Model Evaluation Pipelines

(e.g., to test or tune the performance of your own models) Unless expressly authorised by Valyu in writing.

6. Contents Endpoint — User Responsibility for Third-Party URLs

6.1. Your Obligations When Submitting URLs

The Contents API endpoint (/v1/contents) extracts and processes content from URLs that you provide. By submitting any URL to the Contents endpoint, you represent and warrant that: (a) You have reviewed and are in compliance with the terms of service, acceptable use policy, and any other applicable usage terms of the target website or service from which content will be extracted. (b) You have reviewed the target website's robots.txt file and any other machine-readable access directives (including but not limited to X-Robots-Tag HTTP headers and <meta name="robots"> directives) and have confirmed that automated extraction of the requested content is not prohibited by those directives. (c) Your use of the extracted content complies with all applicable copyright, intellectual property, data protection, and other laws in the jurisdictions in which you and the target website operate.

6.2. Valyu's Role

Valyu processes URLs submitted by you as a technical service provider. Valyu does not independently verify the terms of service or access permissions of third-party websites submitted via the Contents endpoint. You — not Valyu — are the party responsible for ensuring that your use of the Contents endpoint in connection with any given URL is lawful and authorised.

6.3. Indemnification

You agree to indemnify and hold harmless Valyu, its officers, directors, employees, and agents from and against any claims, damages, losses, liabilities, costs, or expenses (including reasonable legal fees) arising out of or relating to your submission of URLs to the Contents endpoint in violation of this Section 6 or any third-party rights.

6.4. Prohibited Uses of the Contents Endpoint

Without limiting the generality of Section 3 and Section 4 above, you may not use the Contents endpoint to:

Systematically extract content from a single domain or set of domains at a scale or frequency that constitutes scraping, crawling, or harvestingAccess or extract content from URLs that you know or reasonably should know are protected by terms that prohibit automated access or extractionReconstruct, mirror, or archive a substantial portion of any third-party website or datasetExtract content for the purpose of repackaging and redistributing it as your own, or in a manner that competes with the source website

7. Caching, Retention & Storage Rules

7.1. Restricted Content (Partner / Licensed Sources)

You may not:

CacheStoreRetainLogIndexReformatCopy any Restricted Content. All Restricted Content must be discarded once the request completes.

7.2. Open Access (OA) & Open Web Content

You may temporarily cache Outputs only within the durations specified by Valyu's Documentation. You may not:

Store Outputs indefinitelyStore Outputs in volumes sufficient to recreate datasetsStore large batches of outputs from related queriesStore Outputs outside the permitted cache window

8. Automated Usage & Query Behaviour

You may not:

Generate abusive query patterns (keyword enumeration, brute-force term scanning)Run high-volume queries intended to perform scraping or bulk extractionUse bots to obtain data at a scale that mimics crawling or harvestingPerform load testing without prior written approvalPerform adversarial prompts designed to bypass licensing or content restrictions Valyu may rate-limit, throttle, or block usage that appears harmful or potentially abusive.

9. Security Restrictions

You may not:

Reverse engineer or attempt to extract Valyu's models, indexes, embeddings, or scoring logicProbe, scan, or test the security of systems without authorisationInterfere with or disrupt the integrity of the ServicesAttempt to bypass geographical, licensing, or content-access restrictions

10. Misrepresentation & High-Risk Use Cases

You may not:

Use Outputs as factual without verifying the underlying sourcesProvide medical, legal, financial, or regulatory advice based solely on OutputsUse Outputs in automated decision-making without adequate human oversightMisrepresent Valyu's data as proprietary to your own organisation

11. Competing Use

You may not:

Use the Services to build competing APIs, search layers, indexing systems, or retrieval infrastructuresBenchmark Valyu for publication without written consentUse knowledge of Valyu's performance or datasets to circumvent or replace the Services

12. Enforcement, Suspension & Termination

Valyu may:

Suspend or terminate access immediatelyRevoke keysBlock IPsThrottle usageNotify rights holdersTake legal action for any suspected or confirmed violation of this AUP. We may also:Update this AUP at any timeChange endpoint rules at any timeModify caching and retention policies without notice

13. Reporting Violations

To report misuse or compliance issues: Valyu Network Ltd 17 Newman Street, London W1T 1PD, United Kingdom Email: contact@valyu.ai

### VALYU PLATFORM SERVICE AGREEMENT

# Platform Service Agreement

VALYU PLATFORM SERVICE AGREEMENT

Last updated: October 20 2025

1. Introduction

This Platform Service Agreement (“Agreement”) governs your access to and use of the Valyu APIs, SDKs, documentation, datasets, models, and related services (“Services”).

The Services are operated by Valyu.Network Ltd (“Valyu”, “we”, “us”). By using the Services, you agree to be bound by this Agreement. If you do not agree, do not use the Services.

You may use the Services only if:

you are at least 16 years old, andif under 18, you have parental or guardian permission, andyou have legal authority to enter into this Agreement.

2. Account & Credentials

You are responsible for:

maintaining the confidentiality of your API keys, andall usage under your API keys.

We may suspend or revoke credentials if we detect abuse or policy violations.

3. Licence to Use the Services

Subject to this Agreement and all applicable Acceptable Use Policies (“AUPs”), Valyu grants you a limited, revocable, non-exclusive, non-transferable licence to:

access and call the Valyu APIs;use Outputs within your applications;store permitted cached Outputs in accordance with Section 7.

This licence does not include:

rights to Valyu’s corpora, publisher datasets, indexes, embeddings, or internal models;rights to reproduce, copy, or distribute underlying content;rights to create derivative models or datasets;rights to build competing search/indexing services.

All rights not expressly granted are reserved.

4. Customer Data

You retain all rights in “Customer Data” you send to the API.

You grant Valyu a licence to process Customer Data solely to:

provide the Services,maintain security,prevent abuse, andimprove system performance and quality.

We do not use Customer Data to train models unless you give explicit written permission.

5. Valyu Data and Output

“Output” means the results returned from the APIs (e.g., citations, summaries, search results).

“Valyu Data” includes:

proprietary indexes,embeddings,scoring systems,enriched publisher content,licensed corpora,metadata, annotations, and link structures.

Output Rights

You may:

use and display Outputs within your applications;store Outputs within the caching limits of Section 7.

You may not:

use any Output for model training, fine-tuning, pre-training, embedding generation, or dataset construction;use Output to recreate the structure of any Valyu dataset or publisher corpus;resell or sublicense Outputs.

6. Restricted Content (Publisher / Licensed Content)

Some Endpoints return “Restricted Content,” including:

Publisher-owned academic, medical, financial, and professional content;Content provided under agreements with rights holders;Non-publicly licensed materials.

For Restricted Content:

No caching is allowed.No storage is allowed.No reproduction is allowed.You must delete the content immediately after the request completes.You may not use it for training, fine-tuning, or dataset creation.You may not display or expose full-text or substantial extracts to end users.

This is a strict condition of Valyu’s rights-holder agreements.

7. Caching Rules

(a) Restricted Content

Strictly no caching or retention.

(b) Open Access (OA) & Open Web Content

You may temporarily cache Output in accordance with the durations specified in the Documentation.

Valyu may modify caching rules per endpoint at any time.

You may not cache:

full documents,large-scope result sets,data in quantities that enable reconstruction of source datasets.

8. Acceptable Use

You must comply with:

the Valyu Acceptable Use Policy (“AUP”), andany endpoint-specific usage rules.

You may not use the Services to:

circumvent paywalls or access restrictions;recreate datasets or build a competing search/index service;scrape, bulk extract, or systematically harvest content;perform benchmark dumping or bulk export of Outputs;use in regulated decision-making (medical, legal, financial) without human oversight;conduct security testing without permission;violate copyright or intellectual property rights.

We may suspend access for violations, suspected abuse, or security risks.

9. Payments & Credits

Usage is billed based on the rates shown in your dashboard or order form.

Usage is billed based on the rates shown in your dashboard or order form.Credits are prepaid and non-refundable.We may charge your payment method automatically for usage.Overages or failed payments may result in suspension.

Enterprise customers may have negotiated payment terms.

10. Availability

Valyu provides the Services on a best-effort basis.

We do not guarantee:

uninterrupted availability,accuracy of data,completeness of content, orfitness for a particular purpose.

SLAs may be available under separate written agreements.

11. Intellectual Property

Valyu retains all rights in:

the Services,indexes, corpora, embeddings, datasets,software, models, algorithms, scoring, and pipelines,any enhancements or derivative works.

You retain all rights to your own software and Customer Data.

You may not:

reverse engineer,attempt to extract underlying datasets,derive model parameters or embeddings,remove or alter copyright notices.

12. Confidentiality

Both parties must protect confidential information using reasonable safeguards.

Confidential information includes:

API keys,unpublished documentation,non-public technical information,customer-specific usage metrics,publisher content,pricing and commercial terms.

13. Termination

You may terminate at any time by stopping use of the Services.

Valyu may suspend or terminate your access if:

you violate the AUP or this Agreement,your usage poses risk to our systems or rights-holder obligations,required by law or publisher agreements.

Upon termination:

you must delete all cached data,all licences terminate immediately,unpaid fees remain due.

14. Disclaimer

The Services are provided “as is” and “as available” without warranties of any kind.

Valyu disclaims all implied warranties, including merchantability, fitness for purpose, and non-infringement.

15. Limitation of Liability

To the maximum extent permitted by law:

You will indemnify Valyu from claims arising from:

# Privacy Policy

See how Valyu collects, uses, and protects your data. We explain what information we collect and how we handle it.

VALYU PRIVACY POLICY

Last updated: October 20 2025

Valyu.Network LTD (“Valyu”, “we”, “us”) is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, and protect personal data when you use our website, APIs, products, and related services (“Services”).

We are the data controller for personal data processed in connection with the Services.

1. Information We Collect

We collect the following categories of data when you use the Services:

1.1. Account Information

When you create an account, we collect:

 Nameemail addressorganisation (optional)password and authentication tokenbilling information (if applicable)

1.2. API Usage & Logs

When you call our APIs, we automatically collect:

request metadata (IP address, timestamp, endpoint called)API key usedquery size / tokens / parameterslatency, error logs, performance metricsdevice and browser information (for dashboard usage)

We do not use query data or logs to train machine learning models.

1.3. Query Content (“Customer Data”)

This includes:

text promptssearch queriesdocuments you uploadinstructions or metadata you send to our API

We process Customer Data only to:

return resultsimprove API performance (e.g., caching, routing)secure our systemsprevent abusecomply with legal or contractual obligations

We do not use Customer Data to train models or build datasets.

We do not share Customer Data with publishers or third parties except as required by law.

1.4. Payments

If you buy credits or subscribe to a plan, your payment details are processed by our payment provider (e.g., Stripe).

We do not store full payment card numbers.

1.5. Communications

If you contact us, we process:

messagessupport requestsfeedbackemail metadata

2. How We Use Your Data

We use personal data for the following purposes:

2.1. To provide and operate the Services

creating accountprocessing API callsreturning Outputsenforcing rate limits and caching rules

2.2. To secure our systems

detecting abuse, misuse, or harmful behaviourpreventing violations of our AUPblocking malicious trafficprotecting Partner-licensed content

2.3. To monitor and improve performance

latency measurementerror debuggingendpoint optimisationAPI routingindexing and search performance

2.4. To communicate with you

account notificationsusage alertproduct updatesbilling communications

2.5. To comply with our legal obligations

Including:

UK GDPRPublisher licensing agreementslaw enforcement requests (rare; disclosed only when legally required)

3. Lawful Bases for Processing (GDPR)

We process personal data under the following lawful bases:

Purpose     .                                            Lawful Basis                      

Providing the Services                              Contract

Securing the platform                               Legitimate Interests (Art. 6(1)(f))

Preventing abuse                                        Legitimate Interests

Analytics and performance                      Legitimate Interests

Account Notifications                                Consent / Legitimate Interests

Marketing (optional).                                Consent (Art. 6(1)(a))

Billing & payments                                     Contract

Legal Compliance                                       Legal Obligation

We balance legitimate interests with user rights in accordance with GDPR.

4. Data Sharing

We do not sell or rent personal data.

We share data only with:

Service providers: cloud hosting, analytics, payments, security (under strict confidentiality).Contracted publishers: never Customer Data—only aggregate usage metrics required under license terms.Regulators or authorities: only if legally required.

We do not expose customer identifiers to publishers.

5. International Transfers

We store and process data in:

United KingdomEuropean UnionUnited States (for certain infrastructure vendors)

Transfers to non-UK/EU countries are protected by:

adequacy decisions, orStandard Contractual Clauses (SCCs)

6. Data Retention

6.1. Customer Data (Query Content)

Stored only as long as necessary to process a requestDeleted automatically within a short operational window (typically 24–72 hours) unless logs are legally required

Restricted publisher content is never stored.

6.2. API Logs

We retain:

security logs: up to 90 daysperformance logs: up to 30 daysbilling logs: up to 7 years (legal obligation)

6.3. Account Information

Retained until your account is deleted.

7. Your Rights (GDPR & UK GDPR)

You have the right to:

access your personal datacorrect inaccurate datadelete your data (subject to legal exceptions)restrict processingobject to processing based on legitimate interestswithdraw consent (where applicable)data portability (for account data)

To exercise rights: contact@valyu.ai

8. Security

We use industry-standard technical and organisational measures, including:

encryption in transitstrict access controlsrigorous key managementaudit logsmonitoring for misusedata minimisationpublisher-specific access controls

No system is 100% secure, but we take appropriate steps to protect your data.

9. Children

We do not knowingly collect data from children under 16.

If we discover such data, we delete it promptly.
